description: This file implements the SqlUploadSessionStore class for managing upload sessions in a Mattermost server, including methods for saving, updating, retrieving, and deleting upload session records in a SQL database.

classes.name: SqlUploadSessionStore
classes.description: A struct that manages upload session records in the database, providing methods for CRUD operations.

methods.name: newSqlUploadSessionStore
methods.description: Initializes a new SqlUploadSessionStore with a query builder for the UploadSessions table.

methods.name: Save
methods.description: Saves a new upload session record into the database after validation.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates an existing upload session record in the database after validation.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves an upload session by its ID.

methods.name: GetForUser
methods.description: Retrieves all upload sessions associated with a specific user ID.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes an upload session by its ID.
